annotation.title_clean: The cyber-physical infrastructure: empowering innovation, people, robots and smart machines to enhance prosperity, resilience, sustainability and security
annotation.title_en: The cyber-physical infrastructure: empowering innovation, people, robots and smart machines to enhance prosperity, resilience, sustainability and security
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Robotics Growth Partnership; Department for Science, Innovation and Technology; Department for Business, Energy & Industrial Strategy
annotation.summary_en: UK government publication page for the Robotics Growth Partnership's independent vision of a cyber-physical infrastructure (testbeds, living labs, digital twins, simulation) to speed safer, cheaper smart-robotics innovation across agriculture, manufacturing, healthcare and logistics. Includes a ministerial response.
key_provisions_or_claims: Proposes a connected cyber-physical infrastructure of testbeds, living labs and digital twins for robotics innovation
Aims to make innovation faster, cheaper and lower risk
Targets sectors including agriculture, manufacturing, healthcare and logistics
Robotics Growth Partnership is an independent advisory body set up in 2019
Minister's response welcomes the report and sets out next steps
